data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'hsta', meaning 'to honor'. This name symbolizes nobility, elegance, and respect in Islamic culture. The name Mahasta carries the meaning “Noble, Elegant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mahasta usually hope their child will grow to embody noble, elegant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
